## Intent

A documentary/informative explainer on India's unclaimed financial assets problem, told entirely through numbers. Walks through the major categories — bank deposits, insurance, EPF, shares & dividends, mutual funds — each landing its own official statistic, building to a "check if it's yours" call to action. Factual, narrator-led, not sensational. First video for the Virasat Video Factory channel.

## Customizations

- Burned-in English subtitles are mandatory (not optional) — required regardless of any default caption setting.
